rule: Always shown with 'verify locally'. Values were entered only where the build was confident from well-established public references (IEC World Plugs for plugs, voltage and frequency; the public left- and right-hand traffic list for driving side; the ITU E.164 country-code list for calling codes). Anything uncertain is null and the app shows 'Not sure — check locally'. Plug letters are limited to IEC types A–N. Sample check notes: docs/research/COUNTRY_ESSENTIALS.md.
